verdict.rationale: DPMA runs public web services and downloadable filing software (DPMAdirektPro), so opting out of telemetry or analytics tracking is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers only filing routes, databases and application procedures, and nothing addresses telemetry, cookies or usage-tracking controls. The robots.txt probe concerns crawler access, not user tracking, so it is not relevant to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
